in_marathi.name: Ardhavathi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ardhavathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ardhavathi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Ardha’ meaning half and ‘Vathi’ meaning moon. This name is associated with the goddess Parvati and represents the feminine energy that completes the masculine energy of Shiva. Ardhavathi is believed to bring harmony and balance in relationships and is a symbol of devotion, love, and commitment.
